na18b3d3d799.s: The original Make in India target for additional manufacturing jobs was:
na18b3d3d799.x: Make in India aimed at 100 million additional manufacturing jobs, with 12-14 per cent growth and a 16 to 25 per cent share. 143 million is the National Manufacturing Mission target.

nbb8454376d3.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
nbb8454376d3.x: PLI schemes came in 2020. The National Manufacturing Policy was 2011, Make in India September 2014 and the India Semiconductor Mission December 2021.

n62a9be3a941.s: The original Make in India initiative of September 2014 covered how many sectors?
n62a9be3a941.x: The original Make in India covered 25 sectors; 27 is the Make in India 2.0 count, 14 the PLI sectors and 12 the champion services sectors.

n3b3607745b2.s: India's manufacturing strategy is criticised for missing which target for manufacturing's share of GDP?
n3b3607745b2.x: The target of raising manufacturing to 25 per cent of GDP has been missed, a stated criticism of the strategy.

n708c6b29953.s: Which of the following is a reform credited with improving India's Ease of Doing Business?
o: Removal of all foreign ownership restrictions
n708c6b29953.x: Faceless assessment is a credited EoDB reform; removal of all foreign ownership restrictions, nationalisation and PSU expansion are not EoDB reforms.

n06857a8d5f8.s: Under Section 80-IAC, a recognised start-up gets an income-tax deduction for:
o: Its entire life as a permanent exemption
n06857a8d5f8.x: Section 80-IAC gives a deduction for three consecutive years out of ten; there is no permanent exemption from all taxes.

nf49d36d4c06.s: Which of the following pairs about start-up eligibility is correctly matched?
o: Entity formed by splitting a business – Recognised as a start-up
Limited liability partnership – Not an eligible form
Registered partnership firm – Eligible form of start-up
nf49d36d4c06.x: Partnerships, LLPs and cooperatives are eligible forms besides private limited companies; an entity formed by splitting or reconstructing a business is not a start-up.

n1bca9c6573b.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Section 18 of SEZ Act – More than one IFSC per SEZ
Section 18 of SEZ Act – Income-tax holiday for SEZ units
Section 18 of SEZ Act – Only one IFSC per SEZ
n1bca9c6573b.x: Section 18 of the SEZ Act allows an IFSC in an SEZ, but only one IFSC per SEZ; Section 10AA is the income-tax exemption.

n93e4cf7b0a4.s: Under the sunset clause, the SEZ income-tax holidays were phased out during:
n93e4cf7b0a4.x: The SEZ tax holidays under Section 10AA were phased out during 2017-2020, not 2010-2013.

n690d57a098d.s: The operational greenfield industrial smart city of Shendra-Bidkin is in:
n690d57a098d.x: Shendra-Bidkin is in Maharashtra; Dholera, the other operational city, is in Gujarat.

new.s: Make in India was launched on:
new.x: Make in India was launched on 25 September 2014. Digital India came on 1 July 2015, Skill India on 15 July 2015 and Startup India on 16 January 2016.

new.s: The nodal ministry for Make in India is the:
new.x: Make in India is steered by the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

new.s: How many champion services sectors are there under Make in India 2.0?
new.x: Make in India 2.0 has 27 sectors: 15 manufacturing and 12 services; 25 was the original sector count.

new.s: Under Make in India 2.0, the 15 manufacturing sectors are handled by:
new.x: The 15 manufacturing sectors are under DPIIT, while the 12 services sectors are under the Department of Commerce.

new.s: The National Manufacturing Policy, 2011 aimed to create how many jobs?
new.x: NMP 2011 targeted 100 million jobs; 143 million by 2035 is the National Manufacturing Mission target.

new.s: The annual manufacturing growth target of the National Manufacturing Policy, 2011 was:
new.x: NMP 2011 aimed at 12-14 per cent manufacturing growth along with a 25 per cent GDP share.

new.s: Which NIMZ in Andhra Pradesh received final approval in 2016?
new.x: Chittoor and Prakasam got in-principle approval in 2013, but only Prakasam got final approval in 2016.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the National Manufacturing Policy, 2011?
o: Incentives limited to the electronics sector alone
A sector-, location- and technology-neutral approach
new.x: NMP 2011 is sector-neutral, so incentives limited to one sector are not its feature; PPP infrastructure and rural skilling are.

new.s: Which of the following was launched on 15 July 2015?
new.x: Skill India was launched on 15 July 2015; Digital India came two weeks earlier on 1 July 2015.

new.s: The National Logistics Policy was launched in:
new.x: The National Logistics Policy came in September 2022; October 2021 is PM GatiShakti and December 2021 the India Semiconductor Mission.

new.s: The National Policy on Electronics was announced in:
new.x: The National Policy on Electronics was announced on 20 February 2019.

new.s: The PLI scheme of 2020 covers how many sectors?
new.x: The PLI scheme covers 14 sectors with an outlay of ₹1.97 lakh crore.

new.s: PLI-Auto requires a minimum domestic value addition of:
new.x: PLI-Auto (₹25,938 crore) requires at least 50 per cent domestic value addition.

new.s: PM E-DRIVE replaced which scheme?
new.x: PM E-DRIVE replaced FAME-II (2019-24); PLI-LSEM was replaced by the Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the PLI scheme:
1. It has an outlay of ₹1.97 lakh crore.
2. Coal mining equipment is one of its sectors.
3. Its incentive is paid on incremental sales of goods made in India.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The PLI scheme has ₹1.97 lakh crore and pays on incremental sales; coal mining equipment is not one of its sectors.

new.s: The Tata OSAT unit approved under the India Semiconductor Mission is located at:
new.x: The Tata OSAT unit (₹27,120 crore) is at Jagiroad in Morigaon, Assam; Dholera has the Tata-PSMC wafer fab.

new.s: Micron's ATMP unit under the India Semiconductor Mission is at:
new.x: Micron's ATMP unit is at Sanand, Gujarat, which also hosts the Kaynes and CG Power OSAT units.

new.s: India's first semiconductor-fab SEZ is at:
new.x: The Tata Electronics-PSMC wafer fab at Dholera, Gujarat is India's first semiconductor-fab SEZ.

new.s: About what share of mobile phones used in India are made in India?
new.x: About 99.2 per cent of mobile phones used in India are made in India.

new.s: Under the sunset clause, Section 10AA benefits go only to SEZ units operational by:
new.x: Only SEZ units operational by 30 June 2020 get the Section 10AA tax benefits.

new.s: Under the SEZ Act, 2005, who can set up an SEZ?
o: Central Government, State Government or any person
new.x: An SEZ can be set up by the Central Government, a State Government or any person, including private, joint or foreign developers.

new.s: The Atmanirbhar Bharat package of May 2020 was worth about:
new.x: The May 2020 Atmanirbhar Bharat package was about ₹20 lakh crore, roughly 10 per cent of GDP.

new.s: India's logistics cost, which PM GatiShakti and the National Logistics Policy aim to cut, was historically about:
new.x: India's logistics cost was historically 13-14 per cent of GDP, which these policies seek to reduce.

new.s: The World Bank's Doing Business report was discontinued in:
new.x: Doing Business was discontinued in 2021 over data irregularities and ethics concerns; DB 2020 was the last edition.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT one of the 10 Doing Business parameters?
new.x: Getting electricity, resolving insolvency and protecting minority investors are among the 10 parameters; ease of living is not.

new.s: India's rank in the World Bank's Doing Business 2018 report was:
new.x: India rose to 100 in DB 2018, a jump of 30 places; it was 142 in DB 2015 and 63 in DB 2020.

new.s: The World Bank's Doing Business report was conceptualised with:
new.x: Doing Business was published by the World Bank Group and conceptualised with the IFC.

new.s: Which of the following was among India's weakest Doing Business indicators?
new.x: Enforcing contracts and registering property were India's weakest indicators.

new.s: B-READY, the successor of Doing Business, rests on how many pillars?
new.x: B-READY has 3 pillars; Doing Business had 10 parameters and the NITI Investment Friendliness Index has 8 pillars.

new.s: The Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 is credited with improving which EoDB area?
new.x: IBC 2016 is credited with improving resolving insolvency.

new.s: GST (2017) is credited with improving which EoDB area?
new.x: GST, faceless assessment and e-filing are credited for paying taxes and a unified market.

new.s: The Jan Vishwas 2.0 Bill amended provisions of how many Acts?
new.x: Jan Vishwas 2.0 covered 16 Acts and 355 provisions, of which 288 were decriminalised.

new.s: SPICe+ (2020), a reform for starting a business, integrates how many services?
new.x: SPICe+ integrates 11 services of 3 ministries.

new.s: Despite the four labour codes, about what share of India's workers remain informal?
new.x: Over 80 per cent of workers remain informal despite the four labour codes.

new.s: The AP Single Desk Portal was launched in:
new.x: The AP Single Desk Portal was launched in April 2015.

new.s: In 2024-25, what share of approvals on the AP Single Desk Portal was given within SLA?
new.x: 16,458 of 16,783 approvals (99.20 per cent) were given within SLA in 2024-25.

new.s: The Asian Competitiveness Institute, which ranks Indian States on ease of doing business, is based in:
new.x: The ACI is in Singapore and ranks States on three 'ABC' pillars.

new.s: In the ACI EDB Index 2018, which State ranked first?
new.x: Andhra Pradesh ranked first (up from 5th in 2016), Maharashtra second and Delhi third.

new.s: In BRAP 2019 (released September 2020), which State ranked second?
new.x: In BRAP 2019, AP was 1st, Uttar Pradesh 2nd (up from 12th) and Telangana 3rd.

new.s: How many States were Top Achievers in BRAP 2020?
new.x: BRAP 2020 had no numeric ranks; 7 States, including AP, were Top Achievers.

new.s: The annual turnover ceiling for a DPIIT-recognised start-up (other than deep-tech) is:
new.x: The limit is ₹200 crore (revised from ₹100 crore); deep-tech start-ups may go up to ₹300 crore.

new.s: A start-up (other than deep-tech) keeps its status for up to how many years from incorporation?
new.x: A start-up keeps its status up to 10 years; a deep-tech start-up up to 20 years.

new.s: National Startup Day is observed on:
new.x: Startup India was launched on 16 January 2016, now National Startup Day.

new.s: MAARG of Startup India is a national platform for:
new.x: MAARG is the national mentorship platform of Startup India under DPIIT.

new.s: The single online platform for all stakeholders of India's start-up ecosystem is:
new.x: Startup India Hub is the single platform; Udyam is MSME registration, Standupmitra is the Stand-Up India portal and MAARG a mentorship platform.

new.s: In the States' Startup Ranking 2022, Andhra Pradesh was placed as:
new.x: Andhra Pradesh was No. 1, a Best Performer, in the States' Startup Ranking 2022.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Stand-Up India Scheme:
1. It covers greenfield enterprises only.
2. Each bank branch should have at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Stand-Up India covers only greenfield enterprises, and each branch must support at least one SC/ST and one woman borrower.

new.s: For a non-individual enterprise under Stand-Up India, the minimum shareholding of an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur is:
new.x: At least 51 per cent shareholding and controlling stake must be with an SC/ST or woman entrepreneur.

new.s: Under Stand-Up India, working capital up to ₹10 lakh is given as:
o: An overdraft with a RuPay debit card
new.x: Working capital up to ₹10 lakh is an overdraft with a RuPay debit card; above that it is a cash credit limit.

new.s: Besides collateral, Stand-Up India loans may be secured by the guarantee of the:
o: Credit Guarantee Fund for Stand-Up India Loans
new.x: Stand-Up India loans are secured by collateral or a CGFSIL guarantee; CGSS is the start-up guarantee scheme.

new.s: The maximum repayment period of a Stand-Up India loan is:
new.x: Stand-Up India loans are repayable in up to 7 years with a moratorium of up to 18 months.

new.s: The ₹10,000 crore refinance window for Stand-Up India is provided by:
new.x: SIDBI provides ₹10,000 crore refinance for Stand-Up India and also manages the Fund of Funds for Startups.

new.s: The Fund of Funds for Startups invests in start-ups through:
new.x: FFS invests through SEBI-registered AIFs (venture capital funds), not directly in start-ups.

new.s: Under SISFS, the maximum grant for proof of concept is:
new.x: SISFS gives up to ₹20 lakh as grant and ₹50 lakh as investment; incubators get up to ₹5 crore each.

new.s: The maximum guarantee per borrower under the Credit Guarantee Scheme for Start-ups is:
new.x: CGSS gives collateral-free guarantees up to ₹20 crore per borrower.

new.s: The Credit Guarantee Scheme for Start-ups (2022) gives its guarantee through:
new.x: CGSS, notified in October 2022, gives guarantees via NCGTC.

new.s: Raising small sums from many people, usually online, to fund a start-up is called:
new.x: Crowdfunding raises small sums from many people; bootstrapping uses the founder's own savings and revenue.

new.s: Individuals who invest their own money in a start-up at the idea or seed stage are called:
new.x: Angel investors put their own money in at the idea or seed stage.

new.s: Udyam Abhilasha, a national entrepreneurship-awareness campaign, was run by:
new.x: Udyam Abhilasha was run by SIDBI, not the Ministry of MSME.

new.s: Swavalambini, the women entrepreneurship programme for female students, is run by:
new.x: Swavalambini (2025) is a joint programme of MSDE and NITI Aayog.

new.s: PM Vishwakarma supports artisans of how many traditional trades?
new.x: PM Vishwakarma covers 18 traditional trades with collateral-free loans up to ₹3 lakh at 5 per cent.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
new.x: ASPIRE is of the Ministry of MSME; NIDHI is DST, Udyam Abhilasha SIDBI and Swavalambini MSDE with NITI Aayog.

new.s: Atal Tinkering Labs are run under the Atal Innovation Mission of:
new.x: The Atal Innovation Mission of NITI Aayog runs Atal Tinkering Labs and Atal Incubation Centres.

new.s: In the Global Innovation Index 2025, India ranked:
new.x: India was 38th of 139 economies in GII 2025, up from 39th in 2024.

new.s: Under RKVY-RAFTAAR agribusiness incubation, seed-stage support for agri-startups is up to:
new.x: RKVY-RAFTAAR gives up to ₹5 lakh at idea/pre-seed stage and ₹25 lakh at seed stage.

new.s: In the Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2026, India ranked:
new.x: India was 4th with 61 unicorns, overtaken by the UK; it is the 3rd-largest start-up ecosystem, not 3rd in unicorns.

new.s: How many unicorns does India have in the Hurun Global Unicorn Index 2026?
new.x: Hurun 2026 counts 61 Indian unicorns, down from 64; the UK has 70.

new.s: The vision of the Ratan Tata Innovation Hub is:
o: Make in India for the World
new.x: RTIH's vision is 'One Family, One Entrepreneur'.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's rank in the India Innovation Index 2022 was:
new.x: AP was 9th in the India Innovation Index 2022, though 1st in the States' Startup Ranking 2022.

new.s: The Falta Export Processing Zone is in:
new.x: Falta EPZ is in West Bengal; Kandla is in Gujarat.

new.s: SEEPZ is located in:
new.x: SEEPZ is at Santacruz, Mumbai; MEPZ is in Chennai.

new.s: The Surat EPZ was converted into an SEZ on:
new.x: Surat, the first private-sector EPZ (1997), became an SEZ on 1 November 2000.

new.s: In 2025, the minimum land for semiconductor and electronic-component SEZs was cut to:
new.x: The SEZ (Amendment) Rules 2025 cut the land requirement from 50 ha to 10 ha.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the SEZ framework:
1. The SEZ policy was announced in the EXIM Policy 2000-01.
2. The SEZ Act and Rules came into force on 23 June 2005.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The SEZ policy came in EXIM Policy 2000-01; 23 June 2005 is the date of President's assent, and the Act came into force on 10 February 2006.

new.s: Under the SEZ Rules 2006, the minimum area for a multi-product SEZ was:
new.x: Multi-product SEZs needed 1,000 ha and sector-specific SEZs 100 ha.

new.s: FDI in SEZs for most manufacturing activities is allowed up to:
new.x: 100 per cent FDI is allowed under the automatic route for most manufacturing in SEZs.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT an objective of the SEZ Act, 2005?
o: Promotion of investment from domestic and foreign sources
Promotion of exports of services only
new.x: The Act aims to promote exports of goods and services, not services only.

new.s: Which State has the largest number of operational SEZs at present?
new.x: Tamil Nadu has the most operational SEZs now; Telangana has the most approved SEZs.

new.s: SEZ exports in FY 2024-25 were about what share of India's exports?
new.x: SEZ exports of about ₹14.64 lakh crore in FY 2024-25 were about 21 per cent of India's exports.

new.s: The DESH Bill to replace the SEZ Act was announced in:
new.x: The DESH Bill was announced in Budget 2022-23 and is still pending.

new.s: Which country is the partner for the Delhi-Mumbai Industrial Corridor?
new.x: DMIC is backed by Japan through JICA and JBIC.

new.s: The Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is funded by:
new.x: VCIC is funded by the ADB; DMIC's partner is Japan.

new.s: India's first coastal industrial corridor is:
new.x: The 800-km Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor is India's first coastal corridor.

new.s: Which of the following States is NOT covered by the Amritsar-Kolkata Industrial Corridor?
new.x: AKIC covers Punjab, Haryana, Uttarakhand, UP, Bihar, Jharkhand and West Bengal; Madhya Pradesh is on DMIC.

new.s: NICDC was formerly known as:
new.x: NICDC, under DPIIT, was formerly the DMIC Development Corporation; NICDIT is the trust it advises.

new.s: The National Industrial Corridor Programme envisages how many industrial corridors?
new.x: The programme has 11 industrial corridors in 4 phases.

new.s: Which pair of greenfield industrial smart city and corridor is correctly matched?
new.x: Kopparthy (Kadapa) is on VCIC, Orvakal (Kurnool) on HBIC and Krishnapatnam (Nellore) on CBIC.

new.s: Sri City in Andhra Pradesh is a:
new.x: Sri City is a multi-product SEZ in Satyavedu and Varadaiahpalem mandals.

new.s: Which of the following is a node of the Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor?
new.x: VCIC nodes include Visakhapatnam, Kakinada, Amaravati and Yerpedu-Srikalahasti; Orvakal is on HBIC.

new.s: Before becoming an SEZ, Visakhapatnam was a(n):
new.x: Visakhapatnam was an old EPZ that later became an SEZ.

new.s: How many Coastal Economic Zones were proposed under the Sagarmala National Perspective Plan?
new.x: The Sagarmala National Perspective Plan (2016) proposed 14 CEZs.

new.s: The Sagarmala National Perspective Plan, which proposed Coastal Economic Zones, was released in:
new.x: The Sagarmala National Perspective Plan of 2016 proposed 14 CEZs under port-led industrialisation.
